📰 Why does Luxor’s $16M funding round stand out amid the convergence of AI and Bitcoin mining?

Crypto hardware provider Luxor announced that it raised $160,000 from CMT Digital. The funds will be used to scale its AI infrastructure business and expand its GPU procurement services, as global chip supply chain pressures intensify. For Luxor, this is both a matter of survival and a barometer of industry trends.

Why does this news matter?
Behind Luxor’s funding round is the combined pressure of expanding AI applications and demand from the crypto mining industry. On one hand, AI development requires enormous computing power, and GPU shortages highlight the value of companies like Luxor that can provide solutions. On the other hand, declining profitability in Bitcoin mining is leading miners to favor more cost-effective GPUs. Luxor’s business model essentially builds a bridge between these two sources of demand. This coincides with tightening global chip supply chains, meaning that it’s not just miners competing for GPUs—AI companies are also stockpiling them at a rapid pace. This reflects a structural shift in demand for computing power, rather than a simple supply-and-demand imbalance.

Market impact
Although Luxor’s funding represents only a tiny fraction of the overall AI or mining market, its business model reflects two important industry trends: first, AI applications are becoming increasingly dependent on computing power; second, the mining industry is undergoing a technology-driven supply chain transformation. The news itself is likely to have minimal impact on BTC and ETH prices, but it signals fiercer competition on the demand side for computing power. This could indirectly drive up GPU prices and, in turn, affect the marginal cost of mining. If demand for GPUs from AI surges in the future, some computing power that would otherwise have been used for mining could be diverted, potentially challenging the long-term value proposition of Proof-of-Work chains such as BTC.

Trading considerations
The figures suggest that Luxor’s funding is not large enough to have a significant impact on BTC or ETH. The significance of the news lies in how it reveals shifts in the industry’s underlying dynamics. If demand for computing power from AI continues to accelerate, it could have a far-reaching impact on the computing power ecosystem across the crypto industry. This means it’s worth monitoring developments in areas such as computing power rentals and chip supply, rather than focusing solely on BTC or ETH price movements.

📰 为什么 Luxor 16M 美元融资在 AI 与比特币挖矿融合浪潮中显得如此特别？

加密货币硬件商 Luxor 宣布从 CMT Digital 筹集了 16 万美元资金，这笔钱将用于扩大其 AI 基础设施业务规模，并增加 GPU 采购服务，而全球芯片供应链的紧张局势正在加剧。对 Luxor 来说，这既是生存需求，也是行业风向标。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Luxor 的融资事件背后，是 AI 应用场景拓展与加密挖矿行业需求的双重挤压。一方面，AI 发展需要大量算力，GPU 供应短缺让 Luxor 这种能提供解决方案的企业价值凸显；另一方面，比特币挖矿的盈利能力下滑，使得矿工更倾向于选择性价比更高的 GPU。Luxor 的业务模式，本质上是在这两大需求间搭建桥梁。这与当前全球芯片供应链的紧张关系形成共振，意味着不仅矿工在抢 GPU，AI 领域也在疯狂囤货。这背后是算力需求的结构性变化，而非简单的供需失衡。

对市场的影响
虽然 Luxor 的融资额仅占整个 AI 或挖矿市场的冰山一角，但它的业务模式却反映了两个行业的重要趋势：一是 AI 应用对算力的依赖持续增强，二是挖矿行业正在经历技术驱动下的供应链重塑。对于 BTC 和 ETH 价格而言，这条新闻本身的影响微乎其微，但意味着算力需求端的竞争将更加激烈，可能会间接推高 GPU 价格，进而影响挖矿的边际成本。如果未来 AI 对 GPU 的需求爆发式增长，可能会分流一部分原本用于挖矿的算力，这对以 Proof-of-Work 为主的链（如 BTC）的长期价值主张构成潜在挑战。

操作思路
从数据上看，Luxor 的融资规模不足以对 BTC 或 ETH 产生显著影响，但这条新闻的意义在于揭示行业底层逻辑的演变。如果未来 AI 对算力的需求持续加速，可能会对整个加密货币行业的算力生态产生深远影响。这意味着需要关注算力租赁、芯片供应等领域的动态，而非仅仅盯着 BTC 或 ETH 的价格波动。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Market Sentiment Cycle: A Six-Act Play from Doubt to Euphoria
translatedData.subTitle:
The script of each market cycle is almost the same:
① Doubt phase: after a few days of gains, no one believes it, and everyone says it’s just a rebound to dump shares.
② Recognition phase: a new high is set, analysts turn bullish, and retail investors half-believe, half-doubt as they buy in.
③ Excitement phase: prices keep surging, people in the group start posting profits, and you begin to fear missing out.
④ Euphoria phase: everyone in your social feed is discussing coins, taxi drivers are recommending coins, and leverage rates are soaring.
⑤ Denial phase: prices start to fall, and everyone says it’s a “healthy pullback, a buying opportunity.”
⑥ Panic phase: prices keep crashing, and cries of capitulation are everywhere — and the seeds of the next round are buried here.

$ETH The third dip below 2300—and all three times, it bounced back

The 24-hour low was 2294.26, on yesterday’s noon candle. Then 2299.59 at 4 a.m. and 2296.30 at 8 a.m. Three breaks below the level, and all three times it closed back above 2300. Now it’s at 2334.

Up 0.49% over 24 hours, with $6.9 billion in trading volume. Looks calm on the surface.

But the positioning looks ugly: the long/short ratio is 3.42, with 77.4% of accounts positioned long. For ETH, that’s an extremely crowded trade.

My take: 2300 isn’t support—it’s a trigger zone built up by stop-loss orders. Those repeated wicks are someone scooping up those stops.

And it’s not just ETH that’s affected: L2 and ETH beta plays like OP, ARB, and ETHFI have higher beta. When ETH makes one wick, they make two.

What I’m doing: I’m not guessing which way 2300 will break. I’ll wait for ETH to hold above 2350 and funding rates to turn positive before making a call. If it dips below 2294 next time and can’t recover, that’s a real breakdown.

Risk: with 77% of accounts long, one genuine breakdown could trigger a cascade of liquidations.

The morning call that “the overnight triple cross turned into a chop center” and the midday call that “it moved a half-step lower but didn’t break out” both held up: starting from the 10:00 close at 79,818, all ten consecutive 1h closes from 10:00 to 19:00 stayed below 80,000. However, one part of the midday view needs to be toned down: “the good news did not warm up BTC, only smaller coins” — by the afternoon, even small coins cooled off. I’ve seen enough in the crypto world to know that most people who get liquidated and leave aren’t stupid, and they’re not brainless either. They’re just too impatient, too greedy, and too emotional, grinding themselves down to death.

Retail investors usually die in three common ways:

A few easily overlooked details 👇

🔹 Timeline: The FOMC meets over two days, October 27–28; the rate decision is set for 2:00 p.m. ET on October 28 (2:00 a.m. Beijing time on October 29), followed by a press conference by Chair Kevin Warsh
🔹 Rate status: The federal funds target range remains 3.75%–4.00%; after a 25 bps hike in September, the market’s mainstream expectation this time is to stay on hold
🔹 Probabilities: According to CME FedWatch, the probability of keeping rates unchanged is about 90%, while the probability of a hike is about 10%; but the probability of another 25 bps hike in December is priced above 70%
🔹 Inflation backdrop: September CPI was about 3.7% YoY, with core CPI around 2.6%, still clearly above the 2% target; elevated energy prices are the key issue at the center of officials’ debate over whether to keep tightening
🔹 For ordinary people: BTC/ETH volatility before the decision is mostly noise; what could really reshape risk appetite is the wording on inflation in the statement, and whether Warsh frames a “pause” as “another hike is still possible by year-end” — leveraged positions are most vulnerable to a sudden shift in expectations from dovish to hawkish

To put it simply: this is more like a preview of a hawkish hold, not an immediate rate-cut celebration. Long-term spot holding and riding out a contract position are two different things; if your position can’t handle the overnight volatility, reducing leverage first is more practical than trying to guess direction.

以太坊当前报价约2315美元，过去24小时下跌0.75%，价格在2300至2330美元区间内窄幅震荡。从近五个小时的K线数据来看，ETH多次测试2300美元支撑位，但均获得买盘支撑未能有效跌破。最新一根小时K线收于2327美元，显示出一定的反弹动能。

关键价位方面，短期支撑位集中在2300美元整数关口，该位置是近几个小时的低点区域，也是心理支撑位。上方阻力位位于2330美元附近，对应布林带上轨位置。若能有效突破2330美元，则有望向2350美元发起挑战；反之，若跌破2300美元，则可能下探至2280美元甚至更低。

二、技术指标解读

从小时级别技术指标来看，以太坊当前呈现出短期反弹、中期偏弱的格局。

均线系统方面，7周期均线约2315美元，25周期均线约2317美元，99周期均线约2346美元。当前价格刚刚突破7均线，正在向25均线发起挑战，但仍远低于99均线，表明短期动能有所恢复，但中期趋势仍偏弱。

MACD指标显示，快线数值为负2.04，慢线为负3.50，柱状图为正1.46。MACD虽然仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图连续放大，快线正在快速向慢线靠拢，即将形成金叉，这是一个积极的看涨信号。

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI为69.5，12周期RSI为56.7，24周期RSI为50.4。短期RSI已经接近超买区域，显示短期买盘动能强劲，但尚未进入极端超买状态。

KDJ指标表现强势，K值66.6，D值52.2，J值95.4。J线已经接近超买区域，三线同步向上发散，显示短期多头占据优势。

威廉指标从负49快速回升至负18.7，脱离超卖区域，进一步确认短期反弹趋势。

综合因子统计显示，15个技术因子中有10个看涨、4个看跌、1个中性，看涨因子占比达到66.7%。复合指标发出看涨信号，数值为0.79，历史胜率约70.8%，表明短期反弹概率较大。但需要注意的是，价格仍远低于99均线，中期下行趋势尚未扭转。

三、市场情绪分析

从基本面来看，以太坊当前面临一定的抛压。现货ETF持续流出，10月26日单日净流出8860万美元，同时有45240枚ETH被转移至机构托管账户，显示机构资金在持续撤离。以太坊基金会卖出2785枚ETH，ICO参与者也向交易所转移了数千枚ETH，增加了市场流通供应。

不过，企业层面的买盘提供了一定缓冲。Bitmine公司累计增持10452枚ETH，价值约2400万美元，吸收了部分交易所卖盘。链上数据显示，OBV指标虽然仍为负值，但正在逐步回升，表明买盘正在逐步接手卖盘。

市场情绪方面，投资者对以太坊的态度较为谨慎。ETF持续流出和美联储决议的不确定性可能继续压制反弹空间。但若美联储释放鸽派信号，加上机构资金重新进场，以太坊有望迎来一波修复性行情。

综合来看，以太坊短期技术面出现反弹信号，但基本面压力依然存在。建议投资者密切关注2300美元支撑位的稳固性，以及ETF资金流向和美联储决议。在方向明确之前，建议轻仓操作，控制风险。若能有效突破2350美元并站稳，则中期趋势可能转向看涨。

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are the Fuel Costs of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to transfer funds and to mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running
a contract) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to the coin price】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing gas fees. That’s why seasoned users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

translatedData.content:
The figure worth discussing in the Dutch central bank’s first-ever statistics on crypto holdings is not the “1.4%” itself, but what it measures. According to PANews, as of the end of June 2026, Dutch households held approximately €3.2 billion in crypto assets through domestic crypto-asset service providers, equivalent to 1.4% of their total investments in stocks, funds, and bonds. The statistics exclude crypto assets held by Dutch residents with overseas providers or in self-custody wallets, as well as indirect crypto investments.

My observation: 1.4% is more like a lower bound than a complete picture of Dutch households’ crypto exposure. The reason lies in the scope of the statistics: they cover only holdings “through domestic Dutch service providers,” leaving assets held on overseas platforms or in personal wallets entirely out of view. The more authoritative official data is, the easier it is to mistake it for a complete picture; here, however, there is a structural gap. Without subsequent estimates covering overseas platforms and self-custody, any conclusion that “Dutch households have very little crypto exposure” lacks a complete basis.

The composition is also worth unpacking. Of the €3.2 billion, around €1.5 billion was in Bitcoin, close to half; approximately €300 million was in Ethereum; and stablecoins accounted for less than 1%. This suggests that the visible holdings lean toward core assets held for the long term, rather than stablecoins used for everyday payments or as a temporary store of funds. The sub-1% stablecoin share may also reflect the scope of the statistics: stablecoins used to facilitate trading may not remain in accounts with domestic service providers for long. The summary does not provide this information, so it cannot be confirmed.

For readers, the takeaway is this: when you see an official figure for a share, first ask who is covered by its scope. The test is specific: will the Dutch central bank later add estimates for overseas platforms and self-custody, and will stablecoin statistics be adjusted to account for changes in payment use? If the share rises significantly once the scope is expanded, that would indicate the current figure is systematically understated; if the change is limited, the lower-bound assessment still holds.

#BTC #ETH #Stablecoins

Source:
PANews (originally published 10-27 at 19:45 Beijing time)
https://www.panewslab.com/zh/articles/01a17d2e-44e4-72c9-ad08-512dacf9a0da

content:
荷兰央行首次公布的加密持有统计，真正值得讨论的不是“1.4%”这个数字本身，而是它测的是什么。据PANews报道，截至2026年6月底，荷兰家庭通过本国加密资产服务商持有约32亿欧元加密资产，相当于其股票、基金和债券投资总额的1.4%。该统计不包括荷兰居民存放于境外服务商或自托管钱包的加密资产，也不包括间接加密投资。

我的观察是：1.4%更像一条下限，而非荷兰家庭加密敞口的全貌。原因在统计边界——只统计“通过荷兰本地服务商”的持有，意味着把资产放在境外平台或自己钱包里的部分完全落在视野之外。官方数据越权威，越容易被误读成全景；而这里恰恰是结构性缺口。若后续没有对境外与自托管的补充估算，任何“荷兰家庭加密配置很低”的结论都缺乏完整依据。

结构信息同样值得拆。32亿欧元中比特币约15亿欧元，接近一半；以太坊约3亿欧元；稳定币占比不足1%。据此推断，这批可见持仓更偏向长期持有的核心资产，而非把稳定币当作日常支付或停留工具。稳定币不足1%也可能与统计口径有关——用于交易周转的稳定币未必长期停留在本地服务商账户里，这一点本次摘要未提供，无法确认。

对读者的含义是：看到官方占比数据时，先问口径覆盖了谁。验证条件很具体——荷兰央行后续是否补充境外平台与自托管估算，以及稳定币统计是否随支付场景变化而调整。若补充口径后占比明显上移，说明当前数字被系统性低估；若变化有限，则下限判断依然成立。

SK Hynix is about to release its Q3 earnings, and even bigger news is that it plans to unveil a new shareholder return program at the same time. The market is watching demand for AI memory (HBM), next year’s performance, and whether the company will pay a sizable special dividend. Samsung and Kioxia are also set to report soon, so the memory giants are getting ready to show their strength. In short: The AI memory business is booming, and SK Hynix wants to raise money while also rewarding shareholders. Investors are watching the drama unfold—and wondering whether this move could affect memory prices.

Why does this news matter?
SK Hynix has been a standout performer in the AI memory supercycle. Its sudden announcement of a shareholder return program is about more than just reporting earnings. It reflects a tug-of-war in the capital markets: With memory prices high, the company wants to retain capital through dividends, but paying out too much could lead the market to think it plans to cut production. Put simply, this is about how companies balance short-term profits with long-term growth as demand for AI computing continues to surge.

Market impact
This news is unlikely to benefit BTC and ETH in the short term, but it will intensify debate over whether memory prices are justified. Crypto investors usually focus on global liquidity, and moves by memory stocks may indirectly reflect how major institutions prefer to allocate their capital. For example, if SK Hynix does pay a sizable special dividend, it could draw some funds flowing out of crypto into traditional markets, though the amount is unlikely to be large.

Trading perspective
SK Hynix’s shareholder return program is more like icing on the cake; strong expectations for AI memory demand are already in place. If memory prices continue to rise, the program won’t change the industry’s trajectory, but it could make investors more inclined to hold memory stocks rather than cryptocurrencies. This means that, at this stage, crypto markets may face competition from a broader range of investment options.

NIP Group是那种"别人不敢买的时候我敢买"的类型。他们现在买矿机，说明要么是觉得$79,929.37的比特币价格被低估了，要么是算力博弈中要占个先机。为什么重要？因为这意味着比特币的挖矿成本曲线在继续变陡峭。简单说：挖矿越来越贵了。

对市场的影响
短期内，NIP Group这种机构行为会提振矿机厂商订单，但BTC价格直接带动效应有限。因为市场现在更关心美联储的嘴炮和CPI数据。长期看，如果NIP Group这种资金持续流入挖矿，会推高比特币的护城河。历史参考的话，2021年那个疯狂时期，大量科技基金也买了矿机。

A calm mind can heal countless afflictions. I entered the scene in 2016 and grew from 800 yuan to 48 million. It wasn’t talent that got me there, but a half-invested strategy that many people laughed at as “too timid.” Being steady isn’t being cowardly—it’s the only skill ordinary people need to survive in the market. 

Divide your capital into five parts and invest only one part at a time. Set a 10% stop-loss: one losing trade costs just 2% of your total capital, and even five losses in a row would cost only 10%. When you’re right, aim for at least 10% profit. Slow is fast; compounding depends on avoiding big losses.

Follow the trend; don’t try to guess the bottom. Bounces during a downtrend are traps, while pullbacks in an uptrend are opportunities. The trend is always smarter than you—don’t fight it.
$BTR
Stay away from coins that have already surged. Coins that rise too sharply in the short term often run out of steam. When prices move sideways at a high level, it’s often a setup to trap buyers. Don’t bet on it continuing to rise; just focus on not doing anything reckless.

MACD is your radar. A golden cross below the zero line followed by a break above it is a buy signal; a death cross above the zero line is a signal to reduce your position. Learn to use this and you’ll avoid a lot of pitfalls.

Never average down on a losing position. Buying more as the price falls only sinks you deeper. Add to profitable positions only; cut losing trades promptly.

Volume and price tell the truth. A high-volume breakout from a low level is often a signal that a rally is taking off. If volume surges at a high but the price can’t rise, it’s time to prepare to exit. Candlesticks can be drawn; trading volume is much harder to fake. $MAGMA

Trade only in uptrends. An upward-sloping 3-day moving average signals a short-term opportunity; an upward-sloping 30-day average indicates a strengthening medium-term trend; an upward-sloping 84-day average often signals the main bull run; and an upward-sloping 120-day average points to a long-term bull market. Don’t fantasize about a reversal during a downtrend.

Review every trade: Why did I buy? Why did I sell? Does my rationale still hold? Does the weekly chart support it? Turn every decision from luck into skill.

Going from 800 to 48 million was the result of a set of rules I could stick to. Stay steady, get the timing right, and trade with discipline—that’s the right path for ordinary people. $ZKP

translatedData.content:
After getting liquidated, watching my account get cut in half, and losing so much I questioned my whole life, here are the only 9 things I’ve learned on my way to becoming an A8. Beginners, take a look and save yourself some detours.
#ETH 
I’m not afraid to admit it: I’ve been liquidated, watched my account get cut in half, and lost so much that I’d stare blankly at my account in the middle of the night, wondering if I was even cut out for this.

After slowly climbing back, I realized something: if you’ve been trading crypto for over a year and your account still hasn’t passed 800,000, what you lack most isn’t capital—it’s understanding.

First, don’t rush when you’re starting with little money. What’s most dangerous with a small account? Going all in at the top and using leverage. You can miss the move and lose your whole account.

Second, you can’t make money beyond your understanding. Blaming the market after a loss gets you nowhere. The truth is, you didn’t understand what was happening. If you don’t understand it, practice with a small position. Don’t force it.

Third, most news is there to get you to buy in so others can cash out. When a real move starts, nobody believes it. When the group chats start frantically calling for trades, the move is often nearly over.

Fourth, generally trade less around holidays. This is especially true with high leverage—that’s when you’re most likely to get stopped out for no apparent reason.

Fifth, don’t expect to capture the whole move with a medium- or long-term trade. Sell a little when it rises, buy a little when it falls, and build your position gradually. Don’t rush.

Sixth, a slow bleed wears you down the most, while a sharp drop can sometimes present an opportunity. The rebound after a panic sell-off is often more reliable.

Seventh, admit when you’re wrong. As long as your capital is still there, you have another chance. Holding on stubbornly only turns a small loss into a big one.

Eighth, keep your charts simple. Familiar candlesticks and one or two indicators are enough. The more you look at, the more confused you get—you can’t think straight.

Ninth, master one strategy. Don’t learn one thing today and another tomorrow. People who make money consistently end up relying on one method they know inside out, and using it over and over.
Understanding and discipline really matter far more than short-term profits.
#币圈暴富 
#CryptoBeginners

content:
爆仓、腰斩、亏到怀疑人生，到现在的A8只记住这9句话，小白们看过来，让你少走弯路
#ETH 
说出来不怕你笑，我爆过仓、腰斩过、亏到半夜盯着账户发呆，怀疑自己是不是根本不适合做这行。

后来一步步爬回来，我发现一个问题：你做币超过一年，账户还没突破80万，最缺的不是本金，是认知。

第一，钱少的时候别急。 小本金最怕什么？满仓追高、加杠杆，行情没抓住，账户先没了。

第二，赚不到认知之外的钱。 亏了怪市场没意义，本质是你没看懂。看不懂就小仓位练，别硬上。

第三，大部分消息都是来收割你的。 真正行情启动的时候没人信，群里开始疯狂喊单的时候，往往已经快到头了。

第四，节假日前后基本少操作。 尤其高杠杆，那段时间最容易莫名其妙被扫。

第五，中长线别想着一次吃完。 涨了卖一点，跌了接一点，慢慢滚，别急。

第六，阴跌最磨人，急跌反而可能有肉。 恐慌砸盘之后的反弹，往往更靠谱。

第七，错了就认。 本金还在就有机会，死扛只会把小亏变成大亏。

第八，盯盘越简单越好。 熟悉的K线，一两个指标，够了。看越多越乱，脑子都不清楚。

第九，一招练到极致。 别今天学这个明天学那个，那些稳定赚钱的人，到最后靠的就是一套最熟的方法，反复用。
认知和纪律，真的比短期利润重要多了

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Out Is a Position Too—and One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that not holding a position means you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings whittle away their capital.

In fact, staying out of the market is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay out,
When the bulls and bears are battling it out, staying out of the market—and staying out after a few losses in a row—the money you save in those moments
is more than most people make from their trades.

We’ve all heard the hunting analogy, but it’s true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital intact, and you’ll have bullets when opportunities arise. Hold on to your bullets.

Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your reasoning), what went right or wrong (in terms of execution),
and what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be amazed to discover: your losses
Your trade history is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never letting winning trades run.

The market changes, but your behavior patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just check your account balance—go through your trading records.

translatedData.content:
ETH fell below 2,300 intraday, then returned to around 2,346｜Geth signature-boundary fix remains a proposal｜I’m waiting for confirmation at 2,362

My view is that the price recovery is worth watching, but a security update should not be presented as the catalyst for today’s gains. “Ethereum falls below $2,300” appeared among the trending topics on Binance Square. When I checked ETH/USD on Kraken, the day’s low was about $2,294.34, briefly breaking below that level. The latest trade was around $2,346.49, the day’s high was about $2,361.69, and the open was about $2,320.46. This shows the market has rebounded from its low, but has not yet moved decisively above the day’s high. Quotes can vary across exchanges and timestamps; the price levels below are simply conditions I’m watching.

What’s more important to understand today is new proposal #36028 in the official Geth repository, for the Ethereum client. The proposal notes that range checks for signed integers in EIP-712 structured-data signatures are too permissive: for example, 128, declared as an int8, should be outside the allowed range, but may produce the same signable hash as -128. The submitter has added boundary tests and proposes rejecting out-of-range inputs according to the signed integer’s bit width. The PR is still Open, so it cannot be described as a fix already implemented in Geth or as part of an officially released version. Nor does this justify claiming that Ethereum’s mainnet has been compromised or that users’ assets have been harmed. The primary source is the proposal description and code diff in the go-ethereum project.

Why does this matter to the crypto market? Signature data is a key part of how wallets interact with applications, and inconsistent type-boundary handling could lead different implementations to interpret the same input differently. For developers, this is a compatibility issue that needs to be corrected and tested. For ordinary token holders, the most practical step for now is to check the signature contents and source shown by their wallet, and not treat an unfamiliar signature as an ordinary login. The existence of a technical risk does not mean the ETH token must fall, and the proposal being reviewed does not mean the risk has been fully eliminated. The Ethereum Foundation has also announced a delay to Glamsterdam on the Hoodi testnet, explicitly stating that the new activation date is yet to be determined and mainnet users need not take action because of the announcement. This is a separate matter from the Geth signature proposal.

For fund flows, I’m only using figures that are complete: Farside’s table shows total net outflows of about $88.6 million from U.S. spot ETH ETFs on October 26; some funds still show dashes for October 27, so an automated total should not be treated as actual zero flows. Corporate holdings, ETF creations and redemptions, and client fixes operate on different timelines, so the rebound to $2,346 cannot be confidently attributed to any one of them. For now, $2,360–$2,362 is the intraday high above, $2,320 is near the open below, and $2,294 is the low already recorded. A fall back below $2,320 followed by a break below $2,294 would invalidate the short-term recovery thesis.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and only consider a small spot long position. My trigger would be a one-hour close holding above $2,362, followed by a retest that holds above $2,360. Only then would I open a trial position with 2% of my total capital; if the trigger does not occur, I would remain flat. The first target is $2,390, where I would take half off; the second target is $2,430, where I would close the remainder in stages. I would place the initial stop below $2,320. If the price falls back below $2,320 after entry or a new official security announcement is issued, I would close the position first and reassess. I would avoid high leverage ahead of the FOMC decision, and I would not present this conditional plan as a trade that has already been executed.

content:
ETH盘中破2300后回到2346附近｜Geth签名边界修复仍是提案｜我等2362确认

我的态度是价格修复可以观察，安全更新不能被包装成今天的上涨催化。币安广场热榜出现“以太坊跌破2300美元”；我查询Kraken ETH/USD时，当日最低约2294.34美元，确实短暂跌破关口，随后最近成交约2346.49美元，日高约2361.69美元，开盘约2320.46美元。这说明市场已从低位反弹，却还没有稳定越过日高。不同交易所及时间点会有报价差异，以下价位只是我的条件观察。

今天更值得看清的是以太坊客户端Geth官方仓库的新提案#36028。提案指出，EIP-712结构化数据签名中，对有符号整数的范围检查过宽：例如声明为int8的128本应超出允许区间，却可能得到与-128相同的可签名哈希。提交者加入边界测试，并拟按有符号位宽拒绝超范围输入。目前PR状态仍为Open，不能称为Geth已修复、正式版本已经发布，更不能据此声称以太坊主网被攻破或用户资产已经受损。原始依据是go-ethereum项目的提案说明与代码差异。

它为何影响加密市场？签名数据是钱包与应用交互的关键环节，类型边界不一致可能让不同实现对同一输入作出不同判断。对开发者，这是需要修正和测试的兼容性问题；对普通持币者，眼下最现实的动作是核对钱包实际显示的签名内容与来源，不把未知签名当成普通登录。技术风险的存在并不等于ETH代币必跌，提案获审阅也不等于风险已完全消除。以太坊基金会另有Hoodi测试网Glamsterdam延期公告，且明确新激活时间未定、主网用户无需因该公告行动；这与Geth签名提案是两件独立事项。

资金面我只采用已完整的口径：Farside表格显示10月26日美国现货ETH ETF合计约净流出8860万美元；10月27日部分基金仍为横线，自动汇总不能当作真实零流量。企业持仓、ETF申赎与客户端修复的时间窗不同，不能把2346美元的反弹硬归因于其中任何一项。眼下上方2360至2362美元是日内高点，下方2320美元是开盘附近，2294美元是已出现的低点；跌回2320且继续失守2294，会推翻短线修复判断。

The key point isn’t whether the United States will actually win, but that it wants to use digital assets as a new weapon to maintain dollar dominance. Why does that matter? In short, it wants to use digital technology to preserve the dollar’s position in the global monetary system.

Market impact
For markets, this is more of a signal than an immediate positive catalyst. In the short term, dollar inflows may continue, but over the long term, other countries will also develop their own digital currencies, and the dollar won’t be able to dominate completely. As tokens, BTC and ETH are more influenced by the broader direction of the global economy. Bessent’s comments may temporarily boost the appeal of dollar-denominated assets, but the impact on other fiat currencies is likely to be limited.

Trading perspective
From a market perspective, these remarks won’t trigger dramatic moves in BTC or ETH. Their prices are more affected by global liquidity and institutional interest. The dollar may remain strong in the short term, but over the long term, competition in the digital asset market will be what matters. 📰 Why Are Ripple and C2FO Using the XRP Ledger to Solve Payment Delays?

Ripple and C2FO announced that they will use the XRP Ledger to speed up supplier payments, using the RLUSD stablecoin to tackle delays caused by bank transfers. Suppliers can get paid faster without having to wait several days for banks to process payments. This partnership directly challenges the position of traditional financial institutions in the payments sector.

Ripple and C2FO have teamed up to launch an XRP Ledger-based financing service that uses RLUSD to address delays in payments to suppliers. Suppliers can receive instant settlement after submitting an invoice, replacing the traditional process that can take banks several days. This is a major breakthrough for the Ripple ecosystem in supply chain finance.

In-Depth Analysis

Why does this news matter?
This partnership is a breakthrough application of digital payment technology in traditional supply chain finance. Bank transfers are inherently inefficient and create cash flow pressures, particularly for small and medium-sized business suppliers. Ripple and C2FO’s RLUSD + XRP Ledger solution essentially bypasses traditional financial intermediaries and uses blockchain technology to reshape the payment process.

Supply chain finance has long been a key focus for Ripple. But this partnership with C2FO directly leverages the XRP Ledger’s instant settlement capabilities to address the biggest obstacle to adopting traditional blockchain solutions: speed. This means the Ripple ecosystem can finally compete with traditional finance in solving real-world business problems.

Regulators have recently taken a cautious stance toward cryptocurrencies, but Ripple has made more progress on compliance than many other projects. As a dollar-pegged stablecoin, RLUSD operates within a compliance framework, and this partnership could earn it greater trust from financial institutions. Unlike earlier efforts limited to cross-border payments, this initiative directly targets supply chain finance, signaling that Ripple’s technology is beginning to prove its ability to solve local business problems effectively.

Market Impact
The direct impact on BTC and ETH is more likely to be felt in market sentiment. Traditional financial systems’ acceptance of blockchain could boost confidence across the crypto market. Although Ripple and C2FO’s business volume is currently limited, this model could be replicated across more industries, creating a demonstration effect.

In terms of capital flows, solutions that improve efficiency like this could attract more small and medium-sized businesses. Over the long term, they could increase cryptocurrency adoption in the real economy. Unlike previous efforts by central bank digital currencies to compete for supply chain finance use cases, Ripple’s approach aims to “replace” existing systems, directly disrupting the current payments landscape.

There are few comparable cases in the past, but one point of reference is how e-commerce giants such as Amazon have reshaped the payments ecosystem through technological innovation. Blockchain’s advantage, however, is that it enables truly instant global settlement, without the geographic and time-zone constraints of traditional payments.

Trading Outlook
This signals substantive progress in the Ripple ecosystem’s commercial adoption. The expansion of RLUSD’s use cases could create a sustained source of demand for XRP. In the short term, however, widespread adoption of this model will take time. This outlook would no longer hold if bank-backed digital payment solutions gain traction more quickly.

Ripple和C2FO宣布用XRP Ledger加急处理供应商账款，用RLUSD稳定币解决银行转账拖慢支付的痛点。供应商能更快拿到货款，不用再等银行几天。这个合作直接冲击传统金融机构在支付领域的地位。

Ripple和C2FO联手推出基于XRP Ledger的融资服务，用RLUSD解决供应商等账款的支付延迟问题。供应商提交发票后能秒结算，取代传统银行多日处理流程。这是Ripple生态在供应链金融领域的一次重大突破。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条合作是数字支付技术在传统供应链金融领域的突破性应用。银行转账本就效率低下，尤其对中小企业供应商造成现金流压力。Ripple和C2FO用RLUSD+XRP Ledger方案，本质是绕开传统金融中介，用区块链技术重构支付流程。

行业周期上，供应链金融一直是Ripple重点布局方向。但这次与C2FO的合作，直接用XRP Ledger的即时结算特性，解决了传统区块链方案落地最大的痛点——速度。这意味着Ripple生态在解决实际商业问题上，终于能和传统金融分庭抗礼。

近期监管环境对加密货币一直是谨慎态度，但Ripple的合规之路走得比其他项目远。RLUSD作为美元稳定币，在合规框架内运作，这次合作能获得金融机构更多信任。对比之前仅限于跨境支付的尝试，这次直接切入供应链金融，意味着Ripple技术方案开始被证明能有效解决本地化商业问题。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH的直接影响更多体现在情绪层面。传统金融体系对区块链的接纳，会增强整个加密市场信心。虽然目前Ripple和C2FO的业务规模有限，但这个案例能复制到更多行业，形成示范效应。

从资金流向看，这种效率提升方案可能会吸引更多中小企业客户，长期看会促进加密货币在实体经济中的渗透率。和之前央行数字货币争夺供应链金融场景不同，Ripple的方案走的是"替代"路线，直接颠覆现有支付格局。

历史上类似事件不多，但可参考亚马逊等电商巨头通过技术革新重构支付生态的案例。但区块链方案的优势在于真正实现全球即时结算，不存在传统支付的地域和时差限制。

操作思路
这意味着Ripple生态在商业落地方面取得实质性进展。RLUSD的使用场景扩展，为XRP带来持续需求逻辑。但短期看，这种模式的普及仍需时间。如果银行系数字支付方案加速落地，这个判断作废。

On emotional days, people forget every bit of wisdom, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position. Never average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw a portion of your profits. The money goes out; your mindset stays intact.

That’s it—just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market; it’s that their execution went off track. Let’s keep each other accountable.

“doubling your money this week.” Make it “no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former is given by the market;
the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

以太坊市场深度分析：现货买盘回暖，两千三百美元关口争夺战

一、价格走势回顾

截至二零二六年十月二十七日晚间，以太坊现货价格报两千三百四十三美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之一点四四。从小时级别K线来看，ETH在过去五个小时内呈现窄幅震荡后反弹的格局，价格主要在两千三百四十至两千三百六十美元区间运行。最新一根小时K线开盘两千三百四十四点六美元，最高触及两千三百六十四点三五美元，收盘报两千三百六十二点九九美元，显示出多头在尾盘发力。成交量方面，第一个小时成交额约一亿两千一百万美元，随后几个小时分别约为一千三百八十八万、一千六百二十二万、九百四十八万和一千两百五十七万美元，首个小时放量明显，后续维持温和水平。

二、技术指标解读

从移动均线系统来看，七小时均线报两千三百四十九点二二美元，二十五小时均线报两千三百二十七点零二美元，九十九小时均线报两千三百四十一点三七美元。短期均线位于长期均线之上，价格运行在均线系统上方，短期趋势偏多。指数移动均线方面，七周期EMA报两千三百四十七点五四美元，二十五周期EMA报两千三百三十三点二九美元，九十九周期EMA报两千三百四十五点七三美元，均线系统呈多头排列。

MACD指标显示，DIF线报八点三零，DEA线报四点五五，柱状图为正三点七五，柱状图在前一个周期缩小后重新放大，表明多头动能有所恢复。这是一个短期看涨信号。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI报七十六点零五，十二周期RSI报六十七点八三，二十四周期RSI报五十九点零七。短期RSI接近超买区域，暗示上涨动能可能趋缓。KDJ指标中，K值八十二点七九，D值七十八点三四，J值九十一点七零，处于相对高位。

布林带指标显示，上轨报两千三百六十二点三二美元，中轨报两千三百二十八点七五美元，下轨报两千二百九十五点一七美元。当前价格触及布林带上轨，短期存在回调至中轨的可能。ATR十四周期报十五点七九，波动率相对较低。

综合来看，十五个技术因子中有八个发出做多信号，七个发出做空信号，多空比例约为五十三比四十七，基本持平。复合指标信号为做空，历史胜率约百分之七十四，短期需关注上方阻力。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪呈现分化态势。从资金面来看，现货买盘在高峰时段净流入约三千六百一十万美元，推动价格反弹至两千三百四十五美元上方。BitMine扩大了ETH储备，增持一万零四百五十二枚ETH，总持仓达到约六百零五万枚，占流通供应量的约百分之四点九五，机构囤币行为为市场提供了底部支撑。

然而，ETF资金面呈现流出态势。现货以太坊ETF在当日录得约八千八百六十万美元的净流出，主要由机构转账至交易所导致。与此同时，以太坊基金会通过DEX清算了两千七百八十五枚ETH，价值约六百四十二万美元，形成直接的现货抛压。

宏观层面，美联储利率决议的不确定性同样压制着ETH的风险偏好。与BTC ETF的净流入形成鲜明对比，ETH、SOL和XRP的ETF合计录得约一亿美元的净流出，显示资金在重大事件前倾向于回流比特币避险。技术面上，RSI六周期触及七十五点八，接近布林带上轨两千三百五十六美元，短期存在超买回调风险。

四、热门代币速览

HAEDAL当前报价零点零二九八九美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之三十五，成交额一千四百七十二万美元，日内最高零点零三三九五美元。

BANK当前报价零点零三二三美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二十七点一七，成交额八百四十七万美元，日内最高零点零三三美元。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Does the Candlestick You FOMO Into Usually Look Like?
translatedData.subTitle:
The price shoots up in one big bullish candle, everyone in the group is yelling “Let’s go!”, and you nervously chase in—only to end up buying
at the top. This scenario plays out every day.

Look closely at that big bullish candle that made your heart race: it’s the one people who are already fully invested hope you’ll chase in and take
off their hands. Chasing after a sharp, high-volume rally is essentially providing liquidity to those who were holding beforehand.

A simple but effective trick: when you feel like chasing, force yourself to wait for three candlesticks. If the pullback comes on lower volume and stabilizes,
you’ll get a better entry; if it drops straight back down, congratulations—you’ve saved yourself a costly lesson. The market always
gives you a second chance, but it won’t give you your principal back a second time.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Refuse to Cut Your Losses, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% focus on? The “all-time high,” telling themselves: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Notice that this thought is all attachment and no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price,
it only responds to current supply and demand.

Once you’re in a trade, you automatically seek out bullish news and filter out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different”—those five words have historically cost traders more money than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is actually simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “what would invalidate the logic of this trade,”
then act when that point comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate the decision from holding the position, and only then can you see clearly.

South Korea’s crypto tax delay still awaits a vote | ETH trading-pair pricing rules are worth watching | Stay disciplined near $2,340

My stance is to watch cautiously, not to treat a “possible fourth delay” as a positive development that has already been confirmed. South Korea’s crypto tax is being discussed among the trending topics on Binance Square. The focus is not only on whether taxation will begin next year, but also on whether transaction records can fully cover overseas platforms. On October 27, the Seoul Economic Daily reported that the ruling party and the government plan to discuss on the 28th whether to postpone it. This is a meeting agenda and a policy expectation; the final outcome still depends on an official decision and legislative amendments by the National Assembly. The current guidance published by South Korea’s National Tax Service still states that income from the transfer or lending of virtual assets by residents will be subject to taxation starting January 1, 2027. There is not enough evidence at this point to report that the tax has “already been delayed until 2029.”

I’m more focused on the pricing details that ETH traders can easily overlook. The National Tax Service lists Ethereum in the ETH market as an example of a base virtual asset for crypto-to-crypto exchanges. Under the current rules, income from an exchange is calculated using the fiat value of the base asset at the time of the transaction and the exchange ratio. Tax accounting is not just about the final conversion back to Korean won. For those with tax filing obligations in South Korea, a change to the start date could mean recalculating how transaction records are retained, year-end holdings are valued, and the timing of sales is managed. The National Tax Service also states that the deemed acquisition cost for assets held before 2027 is the higher of their actual cost and their market price on December 31, 2026. This describes the current framework, not a tax conclusion for any particular account.

As for the market impact, I see this as a timing decision for regional capital, not evidence of a sudden increase in global spot demand for ETH. Kraken ETH/USD is currently around $2,341, with a daily open near $2,320 and an observed range of $2,294–$2,355. The price is above the daily open but has yet to break the range high, so this rise cannot be attributed solely to the news from South Korea. If the policy discussion produces clear language, Korean won market volume, premiums, and cross-platform flows will be worth checking. If the meeting does not confirm a delay, trades based on expectations could reverse.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t chase a long or open a short; I’d stay flat and wait for confirmation. Only if ETH holds above $2,355 and then retests without falling below $2,340 would I consider a small spot position, using 2% of total capital and limiting initial risk to no more than 0.4% of the account. I’d first target $2,380, then $2,410; at the first target, I’d take half off and move the stop on the remaining position up to around the entry price. If ETH falls below $2,320 after entry, I’d exit at a loss. If the entry condition is never triggered, I won’t describe the plan as a completed trade. A sustained break below $2,294 would invalidate the short-term bullish view, and I’d continue to wait. Any official changes to South Korea’s tax system should be confirmed against government and National Assembly documents.

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把“可能第四次延期”当成已经落地的利好。币安广场热榜正在讨论韩国加密税，焦点不只是明年要不要开征，还包括交易记录能否完整覆盖海外平台。10月27日《首尔经济日报》报道，执政党与政府拟在28日讨论是否推迟；这属于会议安排及政策预期，最终还须看正式决定和国会修法。韩国国税厅目前公开的现行说明仍写明：居民虚拟资产转让或出借所得自2027年1月1日起适用税制。把报道写成“已延期到2029年”，现在证据不够。

我更关注ETH交易者容易忽略的计价细节。国税厅把ETH市场中的以太坊列为币币兑换的基准虚拟资产示例；按现行规则，交换所得要用交易时基准资产的法币价值与兑换比例计算。税务核算不是只看最后一次换回韩元。对于在韩国承担申报义务的人，若开征日期变化，交易资料留存、年底持仓估值与卖出时点的安排都可能重算。国税厅也列明，2027年之前已持有资产的拟制取得成本取实际成本与2026年12月31日市价中较高者。这里说的是现行制度设计，不是对某个账户的税务结论。

传导到行情，我认为这是区域资金的时间选择题，不是ETH全球现货需求突然增加的证据。眼下Kraken ETH/USD约2341美元，日开约2320美元，观察区间2294至2355美元；价格高于日开但尚未越过区间高点，不能把这段上涨单独归因于韩国报道。若政策讨论出现明确文本，韩元市场成交、溢价和跨平台流向才值得继续核对；如果会议没有确定延期，预期交易可能反向波动。

如果是我自己交易，目前不追多，也不做空，先空仓等确认。只有ETH站稳2355美元且回踩不失2340美元，才考虑现货方向试仓，使用总资金2%，初始风险不超过账户0.4%；目标先看2380美元，再看2410美元，到第一目标减一半，剩余仓位把止损上移至入场附近。若入场后跌破2320美元就止损平仓；若一直未触发入场，我不会把计划写成成交。若再跌破2294美元并持续，短线偏强判断被推翻，继续观望。任何韩国税制的正式修改，都以政府和国会文本为准。

📰 Is AI’s electricity demand surging? What do Baker Hughes’ orders mean?

U.S. oilfield services company Baker Hughes has suddenly received a major order for power and cooling equipment from an unnamed tech company. It may sound straightforward, but it could hint that the AI industry is starting to add electricity costs to the bill—after all, training AI models requires enormous amounts of power. For the cryptocurrency market, this isn’t a direct catalyst for prices to rise or fall, but it can be seen as an indirect sign of the tech sector’s overall strength.

Why does this news matter?
Baker Hughes’ shift toward providing power solutions for the tech industry is largely driven by weak demand in the traditional oil and gas sector (North American shale oil production has fallen by more than 15% since 2023), while electricity demand from the tech industry—especially AI—continues to surge. This order is like a signal flare: tech companies are adding energy costs to their budgets instead of treating electricity as “free” as they once did. This could mean that the cost of AI computing is shifting from a “hidden perk” to an “explicit expense.”

The main impact on the market landscape is reflected in the flow of capital. If tech companies buy computing servers on a large scale, data center construction is likely to accelerate—and data centers depend on power equipment and services. This could benefit stocks and funds related to semiconductors and data center power equipment. As for crypto, this trend is more of a sentiment catalyst than a direct supply-and-demand factor.

Market impact
In the short term, this news could lift tech stocks and AI-related stocks, indirectly supporting sentiment in the cryptocurrency market. ETH typically moves in tandem with tech stocks and could perform better in the near term. But the long-term trend will still depend on actual demand for computing power, not a single order for Baker Hughes. There have been several waves of AI hype in the past (such as GPU orders from Sparkasse in 2014), but the eventual results have often differed significantly from market expectations. This time, too, we may need to wait for data on actual implementation.

How to approach it
This news suggests that the AI industry is shifting from “hype around a concept” to “realized costs.” If computing costs keep rising, institutions may be encouraged to allocate more to cryptocurrencies as vehicles for computing power. But the conditions that would invalidate this thesis are clear: if aggressive rate hikes by the Federal Reserve trigger a tech stock crash, demand for computing power would also disappear, and this thesis would no longer hold.

📰 AI产业用电需求暴涨？Baker Hughes订单意味着什么？

美国油田服务公司Baker Hughes突然接到了一家未透露名称的科技公司的大额电力和制冷订单。这事儿听着简单，但背后可能暗示着AI行业正把电费算到账单上了——毕竟AI训练需要大量电力。对加密货币市场来说，这不算直接的涨跌导火索，但可以看作科技行业整体景气度的一个侧面证据。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Baker Hughes转型做科技行业的电力解决方案，根本原因在于传统油气行业需求疲软（2023年至今北美页岩油产量跌超15%），而科技行业（尤其是AI）用电需求持续暴增。这条订单信息就像一个信号塔：科技公司正在把能源成本列入预算，而不是像以前那样认为电力是"免费"的。这可能意味着AI的算力成本正在从"隐藏福利"变成"明牌开销"。

对市场格局的影响主要体现在资金流向上。如果科技公司大规模采购算力服务器，意味着数据中心建设将加速，而数据中心建设离不开电力设备和服务。这意味着与半导体、数据中心电力设备相关的股票和基金可能会受益。至于加密货币，这种趋势更像是一种情绪催化剂，而不是直接的供需关系。

对市场的影响
从短期情绪来看，这条新闻会提振科技股和AI概念股，间接给加密货币市场带来情绪面支撑。ETH通常与科技股走势同步，可能会在短期内表现更好。但长期趋势还是要看实际算力需求，而不是Baker Hughes的单个订单。历史上有过几次AI炒作潮（如2014年Sparkasse的GPU订单），但最终落地效果与市场预期差异很大，这次可能也需要等实际落地数据。

操作思路
这条新闻暗示着AI行业正在经历从"概念炒作"到"成本落地"的转变，如果算力成本持续上涨，可能会推动机构进一步配置加密货币作为算力载体。但这个逻辑的失效条件很明确：如果美联储激进加息导致科技股崩盘，那么算力需求也会随之消失，这个逻辑就不成立了。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn't admitting you're wrong—it's the price of admission for a chance at the next trade
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people can't bring themselves to set a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you've bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn't who gets it right more often, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I've ever seen are quicker than anyone to admit when they're wrong. Because they know that whether this one trade is right or wrong
doesn't matter; what matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand shakes as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

title: 山寨季是怎么轮动的？为什么你的币总是最后一个涨
subTitle:
很多人难受的点：BTC涨的时候我的山寨不动，山寨起飞的时候我又没在
车上。其实山寨轮动是有大致剧本的。

【经典顺序】BTC先动（吸走注意力）→ 资金外溢到ETH和大主流 →
再扩散到板块龙头 → 最后扫到各种小币杂毛 → 全场普涨过热，行情
接近尾声。你总感觉自己的币最后涨，因为你买的位置往往就在轮动
链条的末端。

【两个实用观察】1. BTC占比（BTC.D）下降，通常说明资金在往山寨流，
山寨季启动的信号之一；2. 山寨普涨但BTC滞涨，往往是行情进入尾声
的信号，这时候追高杂毛币，接盘概率最大。

【结论】轮动不是平均主义，不是每个山寨都会涨。有叙事、有真实
流通量、有板块地位的才轮得到。与其猜哪个百倍币，不如盯紧资金
现在在哪、下一站可能去哪。

【Trading volume hasn’t faded, so why is ETH still bottoming out?】

On-chain trading activity for ETH remains strong. It’s down 3.8% over seven days, but up 1.2% in the past 24 hours, with the price caught between 2,249 and 2,400. This doesn’t look like a confirmed trend so much as both bulls and bears waiting for the other side to show its hand first. The Fear & Greed Index is at 48, below its weekly average of 54: the market isn’t panicking, but there aren’t many investors willing to chase prices either.

What made me take another look at ETH over the past few days was a vulnerability found during testing of the Glamsterdam upgrade. The original design could have sent staking deposits to builders. The development team initially refused to make changes, but a delay in testing gave them time to review it again, and they eventually fixed the issue. Honestly, vulnerabilities aren’t the scary part; what’s scary is whether the team can correct course when something goes wrong.

In practical terms, stakers care about asset security, DeFi teams care about upgrade compatibility and maintenance costs, and institutional investors bear the reputational discount attached to the protocol. Does the business case work? It can, but only under certain conditions: reliable upgrades can reduce friction for integrating applications and bring more yield opportunities into operation. But if fixes and release schedules keep causing disruption, developers, users, and institutions will all be deterred by the risk premium.

I still haven’t figured out whether the active trading volume reflects tokens changing hands or disagreement during a downturn. ETH has fallen more than half from its peak. The value zone may attract long-term investors, but “cheap” has never been enough on its own to bring capital in. What I’m more interested in now is whether volume can remain elevated after a breakout, and whether the upgrade fixes can reconnect developers, applications, and capital on the same chain.

What matters more to you in this move: trading volume, or the real-world results of the Glamsterdam fixes?

South Korea’s stablecoin FX rules spark debate | ETH settlement demand remains unverified | Testing positions again above $2,355

My stance is neutral to cautious. Binance Square’s trending topics include “#South Korea plans to bring stablecoins under foreign exchange law,” while USDC is also showing increased interest on the six-hour search rankings. These two signals only show that discussion and searches have increased; they do not prove that funds have already flowed on-chain into Ethereum. Citing materials the central bank submitted to the National Assembly, South Korean media report that the bank plans to discuss with the government bringing stablecoins under foreign exchange transaction rules. The South Korean Ministry of Economy and Finance document I can verify directly is a draft amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, opened for public comment in October. It focuses on the registration, monitoring, and reporting of cross-border virtual asset transfer businesses, and is proposed to take effect on December 3 alongside amendments to existing laws. Further regulatory arrangements for stablecoins as a means of payment still depend on the final text; it would be wrong to say the new rules are already in force.

The transmission mechanism to ETH is more complex than the headline suggests. USDC circulates on Ethereum and other networks. If reporting thresholds for cross-border payments or service-provider obligations change, the first effects may be on deposits and withdrawals at South Korea-related institutions, compliance routing, and transfer costs. Only if transactions actually and persistently migrate to Ethereum mainnet and generate fees could they further affect network demand for ETH and its burn rate. If most activity runs on other chains or internal ledgers, ETH may not benefit. The Bank of Korea’s earlier research on the links between dollar stablecoins and the foreign exchange market discussed policy risks and market structure; it was not an endorsement of ETH’s price. Search interest is no substitute for on-chain data.

How has the market reacted so far? Kraken shows ETH/USD at around $2,340.06, with an opening price of about $2,320.46 for the day and a rolling low of $2,294.34 and high of $2,354.99. This indicates a rebound from the lows, but there is no evidence linking it to the news from South Korea. The individual U.S. ETH fund flows on Farside for October 27 are still missing; the page’s automatically calculated total of 0.0 cannot be interpreted as zero institutional buying. The complete data for October 26 show net outflows of about $88.6 million. Given this flow backdrop, I’m reluctant to treat the short-term rebound as a confirmed trend before ETH clears $2,355. I would abandon my cautiously bullish outlook if ETH falls below $2,320 and retests $2,294, or if South Korea’s formal rules differ substantially from current market rumors.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a small spot long after confirmation: ETH holds above $2,355, buyers remain present on a retest of $2,340, and the broader crypto market is not weakening at the same time. I’d enter with no more than 5% of my total capital. The first target is $2,385, where I’d take half off; the second is $2,420, with a trailing stop on the remainder. I’d stop out if the price falls back below $2,320, and close the position without exception if $2,294 is breached. If the news only draws search interest while on-chain activity and price fail to confirm it, I won’t chase. Disciplined trading means looking for policy texts, real-world usage, and traded prices to confirm one another.

韩国稳定币外汇规则热议｜ETH结算需求仍待验证｜2355美元上方再试仓

我的态度是中性偏谨慎。币安广场热榜出现“#韩国拟将稳定币纳入外汇法监管”，六小时搜索榜里USDC也显示热度上升；两种热度只能证明讨论和搜索增加，不能证明链上资金已经流入以太坊。韩国媒体依据央行向国会提交的材料，称央行计划与政府讨论把稳定币纳入外汇交易规则；我能直接核对的韩国财政经济部文件是10月公开征求意见的外汇法实施令修订草案，聚焦跨境虚拟资产转移业务的登记、监测与报告，拟随既有法律修订在12月3日实施。稳定币作为支付手段的进一步制度安排，还要等待正式文本，不能写成新规已经落地。

这对ETH的传导链条比标题长。USDC可在以太坊及其他网络流通；如果跨境支付的申报门槛或服务商义务改变，受影响的可能先是韩国相关机构的出入金、合规路由与转账成本。只有实际交易持续迁移到以太坊主网并产生手续费，才可能进一步影响ETH的网络需求与销毁；若流量主要走其他链或内部账本，ETH价格未必受益。韩国央行此前关于美元稳定币与外汇市场联动的研究，讨论的是政策风险与市场结构，不是给ETH价格背书。搜索热度更不能替代链上数据。

市场已经如何反应？我查Kraken ETH/USD约2340.06美元，接口日开约2320.46美元，滚动低点2294.34、高点2354.99美元，说明从低位有反弹，但没有证据将反弹归因于韩国消息。Farside的10月27日美国ETH基金各分项仍是缺值，页面自动合计0.0不能解释成机构零买入；已完整的10月26日数据为净流出约8860万美元。这个资金背景让我不愿在2355美元之前把短线反弹当作确认趋势。若ETH跌破2320美元并再次测试2294美元，或韩国正式规则与目前市场传闻明显不同，我会推翻偏多预期。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Favors the Bold—or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
“Compounding positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: start with a small amount of capital, use several times leverage to ride a big trend, and compound a few times
to turn it into dozens of times your initial investment. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What Compounding Positions Means】Instead of cashing out unrealized gains, you use them as risk capital for new positions,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to add leverage. While the trend holds, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, those unrealized gains
can go from a few dozen percentage points to zero in just one or two big down candles.

【The Math】Compounding positions is essentially about “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the odds of winning four times in a row
are just 13%. Those posts about doubling your money overnight are backed by 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Keep Adding as a Trend Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
You’ve read the trend correctly and want to add to your position—but how? Going in heavy right away and adding until you’re fully loaded with unrealized gains is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A regular. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% when the first pullback is confirmed,
Once the pullback is confirmed, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position becomes, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more at the top) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you lose your nerve, all your trades go off course.

📰 The new frontier in stablecoin custody: Why has the Mexican peso coin suddenly expanded to six blockchains?

Bitso, Mexico’s largest cryptocurrency platform, has partnered with custodian Anchorage to bring the Mexican peso stablecoin MXNB to six blockchains, while also supporting dollar stablecoins. This could save people making cross-border payments between the U.S. and Mexico a lot in fees and reduce the hassle of volatility. Why has the Mexican peso coin suddenly taken off? It may have something to do with the dollar’s role in Latin America.

Why does this news matter?
There are two key reasons behind this move. First, Mexico is heavily dependent on the dollar: in 2023, Mexicans spent more on dollars than on their own currency. Stablecoins could help address this. Second, cryptocurrency regulations are becoming more relaxed across Latin America. Mexico, for example, just legalized Bitcoin trading this year, and stablecoins are well positioned to ride this wave. Anchorage and Bitso are joining forces to combine compliance and technology and offer an alternative to the dollar. Put simply, this is about the Fed’s rate hikes making the dollar too expensive, and Mexicans wanting to pay in their local currency.

Market impact
In the short term, the growth of stablecoins for cross-border payments could increase demand for cross-chain transactions involving ETH, since Ethereum is the leading chain for DeFi and most crypto assets. In the long run, however, this mainly benefits the dollar stablecoins USDPT and USAT, which are the “American dream” of Mexico’s payment system. If Mexico really starts using MXNB instead of dollars for payments, it could set an example for other Latin American countries. Historically, innovations in payment methods—like PayPal supporting Bitcoin in 2020—have driven up gas fees on underlying blockchains in the short term.

💡 The outlook is neutral to bullish, with a focus on cross-chain trading volume for USDPT and USAT. If more countries follow suit, demand for cross-chain ETH swaps could rise. But this view would no longer hold if Mexico’s central bank suddenly tightened currency controls.

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Risk Rule: Why Being Able to Take Losses Helps You Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
shouldn’t exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losing trades, you’d still have 8,000,
Your account is down just 20%—a few good trades can make that back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34%. You’d need to nearly triple your money to break even—mathematically, you’re almost out of the game.

【Putting it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%.” It’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
is no more than 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work out your position size.

translatedData.title: Scaling Out: How to Lock In Profits While Letting Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaling-out strategy I've been using.

【Three stages】First stage: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell 1/3 to lock in some profit,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset immediately changes. Second stage: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another 1/3. Third stage: Let the rest ride with a trailing stop; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let the profits run.

【Why this works】If you sell everything too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold everything, you often watch your gains disappear and end up back where you started.

ETH rebounds after holding $2,300 | Geth plans to fix log queries continuing after disconnects | Check node reliability before discussing gains

My stance is to watch cautiously and not treat a node patch still in development as a realized market catalyst. Geth, Ethereum’s execution client, opened PR #36026 in its official repository on October 27; it remains open. The proposal describes how calls that have already started may continue running after a WebSocket client disconnects. For heavier eth_getLogs queries, the server may keep processing them until completion even after the user has gone offline. Developers propose closing the connection sooner and canceling these calls when a permanent read error occurs over WebSocket, while continuing to handle IPC and TCP half-close scenarios differently. This is a code review aimed at node resource management—not an announcement that Ethereum mainnet is down, nor confirmation that the change has shipped in an official release.

Why does this matter to the market? Wallets, block explorers, on-chain data services, and trading tools rely on node RPCs. If tasks from disconnected clients occupy CPU or memory for long periods, service responses may slow during busy periods, increasing infrastructure costs for operators. The fix could improve stability under these edge-case loads only after it passes review and testing and makes it into an official release. Even then, greater node efficiency will not automatically translate into more on-chain trading volume, fees, or ETH buying. The Ethereum Foundation’s latest announcement on the Glamsterdam testnet schedule still says the Hoodi phase is delayed, with a new date to be announced. That is a separate event from this Geth PR and should not be presented as evidence that “the upgrade is complete.”

The market’s reaction should be judged by observable price and fund-flow data. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $2,342.17, against a UTC opening price of $2,320.46 and a rolling 24-hour low of $2,294.34 and high of $2,354.99. The price has recovered from below $2,300, but remains capped by the intraday high near $2,355. I have no evidence that the rebound was driven by the PR. Farside shows net outflows of $88.6 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on October 26. The figures for individual funds on October 27 are still blank; the automatic total of 0.0 should not be described as actual zero flows. If the figures are later filled in and show continued heavy outflows, the rebound’s staying power will need to be reassessed. Before the Fed’s rate decision is released, macro volatility may also outweigh news about client maintenance.

If I were trading this myself, I would not chase the price around $2,340. I would only consider a small, directional spot long, capped at 3% of total capital, with no leverage. The entry trigger would be a one-hour close holding above $2,360, followed by a retest of $2,350 that holds; I would enter in two tranches. At the first target of $2,390, I would sell half; at the second target of $2,430, I would sell the rest. If, after entry, the one-hour candle closes back below $2,315, I would stop out and close the position. If the price breaks below $2,290 first, I would cancel the bullish plan. I would also stop waiting for a breakout if the PR review reveals larger compatibility issues, ETF flow data deteriorates, or a Fed-related shock triggers a broad sell-off. If no trade is filled, I would simply record the conditions rather than present the plan as a profit.

#ETH
This is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH is up 1.14%, and its 8-hour funding rate is 0.0100%. That number doesn’t seem unusual on its own. What’s unusual is that it sits exactly at the Binance perpetuals baseline, with no premium at all. In other words, the price has moved up and long accounts make up 75.6%, yet leveraged traders aren’t even bidding one extra basis point. When the market votes with real money, it’s often more honest than what people say.

First, let’s look at what this “zero premium” actually means. The funding rate is the price long and short traders pay each other to maintain their positions in perpetual contracts. When longs are crowded and traders are aligned in their bullish outlook, the rate moves noticeably above the baseline. Right now, the rate is holding steady at 0.0100%. Combined with a 75.6% share of long accounts, there’s only one explanation: the average position size of those 75.6% of accounts is very small, and they don’t have marginal pricing power. The traders holding large positions are either hedging or simply unwilling to pay a premium to take a directional bet. Account counts reflect sentiment; funding rates reflect capital. These two indicators are diverging right now, so don’t conflate them.

The second data point is more worth considering. Open interest is $5.546 billion, and 24-hour trading volume is $6.077 billion, putting turnover just above one. For an asset the size of ETH, that’s not particularly active trading. Put another way, today’s 1.14% gain wasn’t driven by a high-volume breakout; the price was lifted in a relatively thin order book. Thin-volume price rises have one characteristic: they’re easy to push up, but can fall just as quickly, because there isn’t enough buying support to hold the price up. The quality of a rally and its size are two different things, and today’s rally looks weak on the former.

The third point is the risk hidden in the positioning structure. There’s $919 million in long liquidations below $2,205. The current price is $2,350, about 6.2% away. It wouldn’t take a very large drop to reach that level, and once the first layer is triggered, a chain reaction could drag the positions below it down as well. What’s interesting is that the market is assigning no price to this risk: the funding rate hasn’t risen, which suggests no one is willing to pay extra for this tail risk. Everyone is treating it as an assumption that “the price won’t really fall that far,” rather than an exposure worth paying to hedge. ETH has already dipped below $2,300 intraday today, showing that this assumption isn’t as solid as it might seem.

Put the three strands together and the picture is clear: account-level sentiment is extremely bullish, funding shows no premium, trading is relatively quiet, and nearly $1 billion in liquidation positions are clustered just 6.2% below the current price. This isn’t a “strong longs” structure so much as one where “there are many longs, but they lack the buying power to move the market.” True strength would mean funding and open interest rising together, a high-volume rally, and liquidation clusters pushed well away from the current price. None of those three conditions is present right now.

It’s enough to watch two signals from here. First, can the funding rate move above the 0.0100% baseline? If the price keeps rising while funding remains at zero premium, that suggests the move is being driven by short covering or hedging adjustments, not new directional buying. Second, does open interest rise or fall as the price climbs? A rally with rising open interest means fresh buyers are entering; a rally with falling open interest can generally be attributed to shorts closing their positions and passively pushing the price up. These two signals reveal more about the quality of this rally than the candlesticks themselves.

My view is cautious: longs are crowded at this level but unwilling to pay, liquidation positions are concentrated just below and not far away—this is a classic combination of “low volume on the way up, leverage on the way down.” If you do choose to participate, place your stop where the structure breaks down, not where it feels psychologically comfortable. Don’t expect a rally with no increase in funding to give you time to react.

涨 1.14% 的 ETH，8 小时资金费率报 0.0100%。这个数字单看没什么稀奇，稀奇的是它正好落在币安永续的基准值上，一分溢价都没加。也就是说，价格往上走了，多头账户占到 75.6%，可杠杆端连一个基点的额外出价都没有。市场用真金白银投票的时候，往往比嘴上说的诚实。

先看这个“零溢价”到底意味着什么。资金费率是永续合约里多空双方为维持仓位互相支付的价格，当多头拥挤、方向一致看涨时，费率会明显偏离基准往上走。现在费率纹丝不动停在 0.0100%，配合 75.6% 的多头账户占比，只有一个解释：这 75.6% 的账户平均仓位非常小，边际定价权不在他们手里。真正拿着大额持仓的那批人，要么在做对冲，要么根本没打算为方向付溢价。账户数反映情绪，费率反映资金，这两项指标现在是分开的，别把它们混成一句话读。

第二个数据更值得琢磨。持仓量 55.46 亿美元，24 小时成交额 60.77 亿美元，换手刚过一倍。对 ETH 这个体量的品种来说，这个成交水平谈不上活跃。换句话讲，今天这 1.14% 的涨幅不是放量突破打出来的，是在偏薄的盘口里被抬上去的。薄量抬价有个特点：上去容易，下来也快，因为没有足够的承接盘把价格托住。上涨的质量和上涨的幅度是两件事，今天更像是前者偏弱。

第三个点是仓位结构里的隐患。2,205 美元下方压着 9.19 亿美元的多头清算，现价 2,350 美元，距离大约 6.2%。这个位置不需要多大的跌幅就能碰到，而一旦第一层被引爆，连锁反应会把后面的仓位一起拖下水。有意思的是，市场对这个风险的定价是零，费率没涨，说明没人愿意为这个尾部风险多付钱。大家都把它当成了一个“反正不会真跌到那”的假设，而不是一个需要花钱对冲的敞口。今天盘中 ETH 已经跌破过 2,300，说明这个假设并没有那么牢靠。

把三条线放在一起，画面就清楚了：账户层面极度看多，资金层面零溢价，成交层面偏清淡，下方 6.2% 处堆着近 10 亿美元的清算筹码。这不是一个“多头强势”的结构，更像是一个“多头人数多但出价能力弱”的结构。真正的强势应该是费率和持仓同步抬升、放量上涨、清算簇被推到远离现价的位置，现在这三点一个都没占上。

后面盯两个信号就够了。一是费率能不能抬离 0.0100% 这个基准，如果价格继续上行而费率还是零溢价，说明推动力来自空头回补或者对冲盘调仓，不是新增的方向性买盘。二是持仓量在上涨过程中是增加还是减少，增仓上涨才是真买盘进场，减仓上涨基本可以判定为空头平仓带来的被动抬价。这两个信号比 K 线本身更能说明这波涨势的成色。

我的判断偏向谨慎：现在这个位置，多头拥挤但不愿付费，下方清算密集且距离不远，属于典型的“上去没量、下来有杠杆”的组合。真要参与，止损要放在结构失效的地方而不是心理舒服的地方，别指望费率不涨的行情能给你留出反应时间。

$ETH: The Learning Angle: A Leaderboard Is Only the Starting Point

Main question

$ETH moves up on the hourly chart. Volume sits above the usual baseline. Price is at 2350.68. The RSI reads 65.9946. This setup asks whether the move will hold or fade. Direction alone is weak evidence. Sustained volume is the key filter.

Peer view

$BTC and $HAEDAL also move up on the hour. But their volume is not above baseline. All three point the same way. This shared direction does not prove a common cause. It is not measured correlation. It does not confirm capital rotation between venues. It is not sector membership. A leaderboard ranking is just a starting point, not the whole market top gainer.

Limits of comparison

These observations come from the same venue. Hourly differences can reflect liquidity gaps or order flow timing. They are not causal links. The comparison shows alignment, not interaction. A trade based on this view needs a reassess trigger. If $ETH price rejects 2355.48 while volume drops, the interpretation weakens. If price holds above 2312.93 with steady volume, the trend view strengthens. This framework turns a simple list into a conditional test. It avoids labeling the move as viral or inevitable. 配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.subTitle:
Where to place your stop matters more than whether to use one. Place it too close and it gets hit constantly; too far away and one loss can hurt badly.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The drawback is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might land right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place your stop where the setup is invalidated: below key support for a long position, and
above resistance for a short position. The logic is: if price breaks this level, that’s evidence I was wrong.

一、以太坊市场价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十月二十七日，以太坊现货价格报二千三百五十美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之一点一二。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五个小时内从二千三百一十五美元的低位反弹至二千三百五十三美元，整体呈现震荡上行的格局。价格已经突破了布林带上轨二千三百五十美元的位置，短期多头占据优势。

均线系统方面，七日均线已经上穿二十五日均线形成短期金叉，但九十九日均线仍在二千三百四十四美元附近构成阻力。当前价格刚刚站上九十九日均线，能否有效突破这一关键位置将决定后续走势的方向。从成交量来看，第三个小时出现了明显的放量上涨，成交额达到四千六百五十六万美元，是正常时段的两倍以上，显示有资金在积极推动价格上行。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，DIF线已经上穿信号线形成看多交叉，柱状图扩大至正四点八五，动能持续增强。RSI六周期指标攀升至七十六点七八，进入超买区域，十二周期RSI为六十六点四一，同样偏高。KDJ指标中K值为八十五点八，J值达到一百零七点一，显示短期超买状态明显。

威廉指标读数为负三点八九，接近极端超买水平。随机RSI指标达到一百的满值，与比特币类似，多个超买信号的共振提示以太坊短期存在回调压力。布林带方面，上轨位于二千三百五十美元，中轨位于二千三百二十四美元，下轨位于二千二百九十七美元，价格触及上轨后可能面临短期获利回吐。

三、市场情绪与基本面分析

以太坊市场当前面临利好与利空交织的复杂局面。利好方面，Bitmine近期增持了一万零四百五十二枚ETH，其总持仓已达到六百零五万枚，展现了机构对以太坊长期价值的信心。同时以太坊名称服务ENSv2主网上线也为生态发展注入了新的活力。交易所净流入在最新小时飙升至三千六百一十万美元，大单占比达到百分之五十六点二，推动了价格突破关键阻力位。

然而风险因素同样显著。现货以太坊ETF在十月二十六日出现八千八百六十万美元的净流出，机构层面持续减仓的迹象令人担忧。超过四万五千枚ETH被转入机构托管账户，这种持续的机构撤离对价格形成了压制。此外，宏观层面的FOMC会议不确定性同样影响着以太坊的风险偏好，部分ICO时代的老钱包和基金会持仓可能在近期产生抛压。

综合来看，以太坊短期技术面偏多，MACD金叉和成交量放大提供了上行动能，但超买指标和ETF持续流出的矛盾需要密切关注。建议关注二千三百一十九美元的支撑位以及二千三百五十五美元的阻力位。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

【State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. That doesn’t mean you should immediately
...shorting. Instead, be extra cautious about going long at this stage and tighten your stop-loss.

【State 2: Funding rates stay negative】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past have started at times like these.

An asset can be counted more than once: deposit it into Protocol A and receive a receipt token, then deposit that token into Protocol B. Both protocols will count the asset in their TVL.

Bitcoin is currently trading within a range, with the $80,000 mark acting as key resistance and $80,200 as important support. 比特币最近连续两天下跌，卡在8万美元关口上方反复挣扎。根据比特币.com报道，比特币多次尝试突破8.05万美元阻力位失败后，当前价格停留在8.06万美元附近。美国中期选举的临近和美联储政策的不确定性正让市场避险情绪升温，影响了投资者的信心，让一些交易员原本期待的“Uptober”行情蒙上阴影。

为什么这条新闻重要？
比特币在8万关口屡攻不下，意味着多头力量正在衰竭，而空头在犹豫中积聚力量。美国中期选举通常被视为市场的重要转折点，投资者对政治风险的担忧加剧了市场波动。美联储的货币政策预期，尤其是未来加息或降息的可能，直接影响了比特币作为避险资产和投资品的估值逻辑。当前市场的十字路口状态，显示投资者在宏观不确定性下，更倾向于观望而非追涨。

对市场的影响
这种状态意味着比特币短期内的趋势不明朗，可能在接下来的1-2周内继续在8万关口附近震荡。市场格局方面，如果美国选举结果引发市场动荡，比特币可能受益于避险需求；反之，如果市场预期选举结果稳定，比特币可能会因流动性问题而承压。从资金流向看，当前市场情绪偏向谨慎，大型机构的资金流入减少，而散户投资者因缺乏方向感而犹豫不决。

操作思路
当前比特币处于震荡区间，8万关口上方是关键阻力位，下方8.02万美元是重要支撑。这种状态意味着短期内比特币缺乏明确的趋势，适合观望为主，不宜轻易追涨或杀跌。如果市场在选举后出现大幅波动，比特币可能会迅速反应，但具体方向仍需结合后续美联储政策动向来判断。

title:
Коли уява стає джерелом страждання

‎
subTitle:
‎Анатомія тривоги: чому ми переживаємо через те, чого може ніколи не статися
‎DVA ANALYTICS • ФАКТ -> МЕХАНІЗМ -> ПСИХОЛОГІЯ -> РИЗИК -> РІШЕННЯ
‎ Коли уява стає джерелом страждання
‎Ми нерідко проживаємо події ще до того, як вони відбулися. Уявляємо погані новини, втрату близьких, фінансові труднощі, хвороби, невдачі. Подія ще не настала, а організм уже реагує так, ніби небезпека поруч.
‎Ми втомлюємося не лише від того, що відбувається насправді, а й від нескінченного потоку сценаріїв, які створює наша свідомість.
‎Але чи означає це, що всі наші переживання марні? Ні. Тривога може попереджати про реальну небезпеку. Проблема виникає тоді, коли можливість ми сприймаємо як неминучість, а припущення — як доведений факт.
‎
1. ‎ФАКТ — мозок прагне передбачати небезпеку
‎
‎Людський мозок постійно оцінює навколишнє середовище, шукає закономірності та намагається передбачити майбутнє. Це важливий механізм виживання.
‎
‎Нашим предкам було корисніше заздалегідь помітити можливу загрозу, ніж проігнорувати її. Тому увага людини схильна особливо чутливо реагувати на потенційні небезпеки.
‎
‎Однак у сучасному світі загрозою для психіки може стати навіть подія, яка існує лише в уяві.
‎
‎Ми думаємо: «А якщо я втрачу роботу?», «А якщо станеться щось із рідними?», «А якщо завтра все зміниться на гірше?»
‎
‎Саме слово «якщо» відкриває безліч можливих сценаріїв. Але можливість події ще не є доказом того, що вона відбудеться.
‎
1. ‎МЕХАНІЗМ — як припущення перетворюється на переживання
‎
‎Тривога часто розвивається за певним ланцюгом:
‎
‎Невизначеність • тривожна думка • негативний сценарій • емоційна реакція • фізичне напруження.
‎
‎Наприклад, людина не отримала відповіді на важливе повідомлення. Факт простий: відповіді поки немає.
‎
‎Але свідомість може запропонувати інше пояснення: «На мене образилися», «Сталося щось погане», «Наші стосунки руйнуються».
‎
‎Людина починає переживати через власну інтерпретацію, хоча справжня причина мовчання їй невідома.
‎
‎Так виникає принципова різниця між подією та її поясненням.
‎
· ‎Факт: те, що можна перевірити.
· ‎Припущення: можливе пояснення факту.
· ‎Прогноз: оцінка того, що може статися.
· ‎Страх: емоційна реакція на сприйняту загрозу.
‎
‎Якщо не розрізняти ці поняття, думки можуть створювати враження реальності, якої насправді ще немає.
‎
1. ‎ПСИХОЛОГІЯ — чому негативні сценарії здаються переконливими
‎
‎Є кілька психологічних механізмів, які посилюють тривогу.
‎
‎Катастрофізація. Ми уявляємо найгірший результат і починаємо сприймати його як найбільш імовірний.
‎
‎Негативне упередження. Загрози та неприємні події часто привертають більше уваги, ніж нейтральні або позитивні сигнали.
‎
‎Непереносимість невизначеності. Нам важко залишатися в ситуації, коли немає однозначної відповіді. Тому мозок іноді віддає перевагу навіть негативному поясненню перед відсутністю пояснення.
‎
‎Румінація. Людина знову й знову прокручує ті самі думки, намагаючись знайти рішення. Але повторення без нової інформації не обов'язково наближає до відповіді.
‎
‎Так утворюється замкнене коло: ми переживаємо, щоб підготуватися до небезпеки, але надмірні переживання виснажують нас і ускладнюють тверезу оцінку ситуації.
‎
‎Важливо пам'ятати: тривожна думка не є ознакою слабкості. Це досвід, з яким стикаються багато людей. Іноді тривога стає надмірною не через реальну величину загрози, а через спосіб, у який ми її оцінюємо.
‎
1. ‎РИЗИК — коли тривога починає керувати життям
‎
‎Проблема полягає не тільки в неприємних емоціях. Тривале переживання може впливати на сон, концентрацію, стосунки, працездатність і здатність ухвалювати рішення.
‎
‎Людина може:
‎
· ‎відкладати важливі кроки через страх помилки;
· ‎відмовлятися від можливостей, перебільшуючи можливі втрати;
· ‎постійно шукати запевнень, але ненадовго заспокоюватися;
· ‎приймати поспішні рішення лише для того, щоб позбутися невизначеності;
· ‎втрачати сили на сценарії, які не потребують жодних дій сьогодні.
‎
‎Особливо небезпечно плутати спокій із бездіяльністю, а постійне хвилювання — з відповідальністю.
‎
‎Можна ретельно підготуватися до ризику й водночас не дозволяти йому поглинати все життя.
‎
‎І навпаки: можна багато переживати, але нічого не робити для зменшення реальної небезпеки.
‎
‎Тривога не вимірює точність прогнозу. А кількість переживань не визначає якість підготовки.
‎
1. ‎РІШЕННЯ — як повернути контроль над власними думками
‎
‎Мета не в тому, щоб ніколи не хвилюватися. Це нереалістично. Мета — навчитися розрізняти реальну проблему, невизначеність і сценарій, створений уявою.
‎
‎Практичний алгоритм із шести кроків
‎
‎Крок 1. Назвіть факт.
‎
‎Запитайте себе: що саме сталося? Опишіть ситуацію одним-двома реченнями без припущень та емоційних оцінок.
‎
‎Крок 2. Відокремте думку від реальності.
‎
‎Замість «Я точно зазнаю невдачі» скажіть собі: «Я боюся невдачі, але поки не знаю, чим усе закінчиться».
‎
‎Це не самообман і не заперечення небезпеки. Це точніше формулювання того, що вам відомо.
‎
‎Крок 3. Перевірте ймовірність.
‎
